test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence contains some errors. Select the option that correctly rectifies the error.

The forses that genarate conditions conduciive to crime and riiots are stronger in urban communities than in rurral areas.

options.text: The forsec that genarate conditions conduciive to crime and riots are stronger in urban communities than in rurall areas.
The forces that genereta conditions conducieve to crime and riotts are stronger in urban communities than in rural areas.
The forces that generate conditions conducive to crime and riots are stronger in urban communities than in rural areas.
The forces that genarete conditions conduciive to crime and riots are stronger in urban communities than in ruraal areas.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the following words contain spelling errors:
 
 
• forses should be forces.
 
• genarate should be generate.
 
• conduciive should be conducive.
 
• riiots should be riots.
 
• rurral should be rural.
 
 
 
• Correcting these spelling errors will make the sentence grammatically accurate and readable.

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.
